title: A customer with records still cannot be deleted
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Customers — View' and 'Customers — Create & Edit'.
  • Use the staging site with the Tiered Pricing release (and the Tiered Pricing QA site too, once it exists); production is not needed.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with a vehicle.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page from Customers.
  2. Delete customer A from its page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A's page opens.

Step 2:

  • The delete is refused as today.
  • Customer A's page still shows.
